transferableLogicOnly: Use world-anchored icon+quantity+cost markers for actionable nodes.
Keep player, workers, customers, stock and register active in one continuous scene.
Show completion as a persistent world state (for example MAX/filled/active), not only a number change.
Use customer reaction and product quantity to make service outcome legible.
Treat timed rewards as optional acceleration, not a requirement for the core loop.
forbiddenCopying: Monkey Mart branding, monkey characters, banana/corn/egg content, exact map/layout, fonts, icon shapes, text banners, MAX lettering, exact costs, ad labels, or asset silhouettes
